verdict.rationale: Airweave syncs app and database data into searchable collections and uses vector search. Its agentic search can navigate parent/child/sibling entity hierarchies, but that is a related feature, not a documented knowledge-graph memory store of entities and relationships. Nothing in the evidence shows memory storage as a graph or graph-based multi-hop querying.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can store memories as a knowledge graph of entities and relationships so multi-hop and entity-centric questions are answerable
